summary.name: Carrol
summary.excerpt: Carrol is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Carrol is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: As an NPC character, Carrol first appears in the Festive Event, A Colorful Hunt.

sections.title: History
sections.content: In A Colorful Hunt, Carrol is informed by Mr. Hummingbird about a "strange bunny-thing" that has never been seen before and is on a search for her. Later then, Carrol is encountered by this creature known as Cotton and is ordered to hand over the rainbow eggs she collected. Cotton engages Carrol into a battle, but is defeated as a result. Carrol explains to Cotton that had it asked nicely, she would have shared the rainbow eggs with it. Much to Carrol's surprise, Cotton fails to understand the meaning of what sharing is. Carrol feeds Cotton with "snacks and drinks" to help it understand a new perspective of life. To help it further, Carrol invites Cotton to her group to adventure together in Grand Gaia.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content: Carrol is a bright girl with an uplifting character. She is also generous and caring in that she helps Cotton to conform to a positive view of life by teaching it how to share and have fun, despite the wrong doings Cotton had done before.

sections.title: Cotton
sections.content: Carrol had a relatively rough first impression of Cotton upon first encountering it, especially considering Cotton provoked her. However, seeing how it struggled with understanding what sharing is about, Carrol felt Cotton can learn to understand a new perspective of life by having it adventure with her.
